WITH numbered AS (SELECT "customer360_id",count(*) OVER(PARTITION BY "customer360_id") AS "__window_frequency",
              row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY "customer360_id") AS "__window_sequence" FROM "marts"."customer360__customer")
              SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE "__window_frequency">1 AND "__window_sequence"=1),count(*) FILTER(WHERE "__window_frequency">1),
              count(*) FILTER(WHERE "__window_frequency">1 AND "__window_sequence">1),count(*) FILTER(WHERE "customer360_id" IS NULL) FROM numbered
